data.name: Aania
data.gender_notes: Aania is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'anā' which means 'to support'. The name Aania symbolizes the nourishment and support that a mother provides to her child. This name is a reminder of the importance of motherly love and care in the Islamic tradition. The name Aania carries the meaning “Nourishing, Supportive” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aania usually hope their child will grow to embody nourishing, supportive and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the spirit of nurturing and care.
data.etymology: Aania belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Nourishing, Supportive.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aania total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
